terms.definition: The number of nuclei that decay per second, A = λN, in becquerels.
The probability per unit time that a nucleus will decay.
terms.examiner: λ = ln 2 / T½. Unit s⁻¹ (or any time unit consistently).

terms.definition: The average time taken for the number of undecayed nuclei (or the activity) to halve.
It is impossible to predict when a particular nucleus will decay.
terms.examiner: Shown by fluctuations in count rate.

terms.definition: Decay is not affected by external conditions such as temperature or pressure.
Radiation that is always present from natural and artificial sources.
terms.examiner: Subtract the background count before using count rates.
